primer: VIT: health. INT: spell power and essence. STR: a little spell power. AGI: move speed and a little spell power.

looking.why: INT makes your spells and your legion hit harder; VIT keeps you and your thralls alive.
looking.weapons: Scythe and Skull Focus: fight beside your legion; a gold or better skull adds a thrall.

weakest.text: Feet: empty. Anything is an upgrade.
Hands: empty. Anything is an upgrade.
Main hand: empty. Any main hand is an upgrade.
Off hand: empty. Any off hand is an upgrade.
Ring: empty. Any ring is an upgrade.

lines.label: Health
lines.help: How much you can take before you fall. Comes from VIT and level.

lines.label: Spell power
lines.help: Scales the damage of every rite. Mostly INT; STR and AGI add a little.

lines.label: Max essence
lines.help: The pool your rites draw from. INT raises it.

lines.label: Essence/s
lines.help: How fast essence returns each second. INT helps a little.

lines.label: Move speed
lines.help: How fast you walk. Every AGI adds 0.3%.

lines.label: Thrall health
lines.help: Each thrall has 45% of your health, so VIT feeds your army too.

lines.label: Thrall damage
lines.help: Each thrall hits for 40% of your spell power (before a staff boost).

lines.label: Damage upgrade
lines.help: Bought with gold from the HUD: each tier adds spell power.

rows.label: 5 pieces · Legion Call: Thralls hit +14% harder · +1 thrall cap

lines.label: No affixes worn
lines.help: Gear can drop with an item level and up to three affixes. Hover a piece in your bag to see what each would do for you.

lines.label: AGI
lines.help: Move speed and a little spell power.

lines.label: INT
lines.help: Spell power, essence and essence regeneration.

lines.label: VIT
lines.help: Health, and through it thrall health.
